tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rgyal ba rang byung rdo rje la dri

tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / chos kyi rje dpal rang byung rdo rje'i spyan sngar dri ba'i tshig le'ur bcad pa/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi zhabs sen nyin byed ltar dmar ba/ /'od zer stong gi drwa bas mdzes 'bar zhing*/ /'gro mchog skye bo'i gtsug na 'dzum pa gang*/ /de ring bdag blo pad tshal g.yo bas 'dud/ /gang zhig thos nas 'khor ba'i mthar 'byin zhing*/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lam/ /chos bde bsil bas rnyog bral 'dus ma byas/ /rang byung rgyal po'i don 'di snyan du gsol/ /'di na gang blo'i the tshom gcod mdzad cing*/ /zab zhi bde chen lhun grub rdo rje'i thugs/ /mnyam sbyor kun mkhyen nyid las gzhan 'ga' med/ /de slad bdag gis zhus 'di gnang bar mdzod/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas de gang zhig /sems nyid yin na 'gro kun la/ /yod phyir sems nyid thog mtha' med/ /de la dang po ji ltar rung*/ /'on te sangs rgyas gzhan yod na//tshogs gnyis sngon du song ma song*/ /song na tshogs gnyis ston pa po/ /yod na de nyid dang po 'gal/ / med na rang bzhin dran pa po/ /gdod ma'i gang zag de su zhig /tshogs gnyis sngon du ma song na/ /sems nyid ma yin tshogs ma bsags/ /de 'dra'i sangs rgyas mtshar cig kye/ /mdo dang rgyud sder 'gro kun la/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe 'od zer sogs/ /dar yug chen po'i dpes bstan pa/ /don la yod dam med pa nyid/ /med na gzhi dus sems can la/ /de med phyir na 'bras dus su/ /bsgrub kyang sangs rgyas rung ma yin/ /dag rgyu med phyir dag 'bras med/ /sangs rgyas rung ba ma yin no/ /don la yod na rtag ther zug /bdag bzhin 'gyur zhing 'bad med kyang*/ /'tshang rgyar ci phyir rung ma yin/ /dri mas bsgribs phyir 'bad ce na/ /gdod nas dag pa'i chos sku la/ / bsgrib bya sgrib byed gang la 'thad/ /de nyid sems nyid yin lugs la/

/dri mas sgrib par mi 'gyur na/ /gzhan la dri mas bsgribs ci gnod/ /lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang*/ /don la yod na bdag mtshungs gsungs/ / gzhan yang bde gshegs khams de ni/ /dri ma bral tshe snang bar 'gyur/ /gzhi dus nyid nas yod ce na/ /rdo rje gdan 'gro'i skye bo la/ /rdo rje gdan dang de yi lam/ /gzhi nas sems la yod ces mtshungs/ /rgyu la 'bras gnas skyon du 'gyur/ /zhi khro la sogs 'gro kun la/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /don la yod dam med pa nyid/ /med na mdo dang rgyud sder gsungs/ /la las sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ /de la dper ni rung ma yin/ /yod na lus sems gang la yod/ /lus la yod na shi ba'i tshe/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams lus bzhin 'gyur/ /sems la yod na sems de ni/ /mgo mjug med phyir lha gnas dang*/ /brten pa'i lha rnams ji ltar 'grub/ /'khor 'das snga phyi dus mnyam bzhag /srid snga nyid na srid pa de/ /dang po gang las byung ba nyid/ /ma rig las las byung zhe na/ /de yang dang po gang las byung*/ /sems nyid las byung de lta na/ /sems nyid skye med dngos po med/ /de la ma rig la sogs pa'i/ /rgyu rkyen dngos po 'byung ba ni/ /dngos med las dngos 'byung ltar 'gyur/ /'on te ma rig la sogs las/ /gzhan 'byung srid pa yod ce na/ /mtshar cig sngon med bzhad gad rgyu/ /mya ngan 'das snga de ltar na/ /'gro bas ma bsgrubs sa lam bgrod/ /de 'dra'i myang 'das ji lta bu/ /mnyam bzhag gang zhig gang gis sgrub/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed med na yang*/ /'khor 'das gzod nas tha dad na/ /srid ni ther zug sangs rgyas min/ /mya ngan 'das lam don med 'gyur/ / gzhan yang zhi bas srid snga na/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dang po rang*/ /lam sgrub dge sdig ston pa nyid/ /mi 'gyur thams cad de dus mtshungs/ /dmus long mnyam pos mnyam po la/ /lam mkhan mi nus nyid bzhin no/

/'khrul 'di rgyu bcas rgyu med zhig /rgyu bcas yin na dang po yi/ /'khrul rgyu de la rgyu yod med/ /yod na dang po'i 'khrul rgyur 'gal/ /med na rgyu med 'khrul rgyu med/ / dang po 'khrul pa mi 'dod na/ /da lta'i 'khrul pa rigs mi 'gyur/ /'on te 'khrul pa'i rgyu med na/ /sna tshogs 'khrul 'di gang las byung*/ /chos can chos nyid gcig tha dad/ /gzhan yin dang po nyid ce na/ /chos nyid 'khrul pa sna tshogs 'gyur/ /tha dad nyid ni chos rang bzhin/ /tha dad chos can chos nyid du/ /'gyur ba de 'dra gang las yin/ /gnyis yin na'ang skyon gnyis po/ /snga ma bzhin du so na gnas/ /'on te gcig dang tha dad min/ /don min nyid na chos can dang*/ /chos nyid so sor bzhag med 'gyur/ /ma rig la sogs 'gro 'khor ba'i/ /sgrib pa gar brten ji ltar sgrib/ /sems nyid gzhi rtsa kun dang bral/ / rten med rang bzhin skye ba med/ /ye nas stong la sgrib mi nus/ / 'on te sna tshogs sems sgrib na/ /de nyid sgrib yin sgrib ci dgos/ /de lta na yang sgrib ce na/ /sna tshogs sems gang gang las byung*/ /da lta gar gnas ji ltar sgrib/ / sems ni sems nyid la brten na/ /sems nyid gang la brten pa yin/ /rten sa med na brten pa med/ /rten med sgrib pas su la sgrib/ /'khor bar 'ching byed grub ma yin/ /lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu rnams/ /ngo bo gcig gam so so ba/ / gcig na dang po bar dang mtha'/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras bstan min nam/ /'o na tha dad nyid ce na/ /de dag ngo bo mi gcig pa'i/ /chos kyis ya bral don mi 'grub/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag rnal 'byor pa/ /gang snang rang sar 'jog pa na/ /snang yul tha mal snang 'di dang*/ /goms yul lha sku thig le 'od/ /la sogs mi g.yo mngon sum lam/ /snang ba'i yul la khyad yod med/ /yod na gang snang thams cad kun/ /rgyal bas mnyam nyid gsungs dang 'gal/ /med na mchog gi stong gzugs nyid/

/ mthong ba tsam gyis mtha' yas pa'i/ /yon tan rgyud sder gsungs pa 'gal/ /dbang po rnon po las dang po/ /'bad pas tshe gcig sangs rgyas nyid/ /'thob ces gsungs pa de yang gang*/ /sa dang lam ni gang du 'du/ /rgyal dang rig 'dzin gang zag rnams/ /dgongs dang brda dang snyan khung brgyud/ /gsungs na dgongs pa'i brgyud lung gang*/ /kun bzang chos sku chen po de/ /dgongs dang ma dgongs mtha' las 'das/ /de yis gzhan la ji ltar brgyud/ /rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa yang*/ /tshig dang yi ger chos bstan par/ /gsungs na brda yis ji ltar brgyud/ /snyan khung brgyud dang khyad ci yod/ /'khor 'das dang po'i gyes mtshams sam/ /dbye gzhi gang las ji ltar byung*/ /sems can gsar skye yod dam med/ /yod na sems can thog mtha' nyid/ /yod 'gyur 'khor ba'i thog mtha' yod/ /med na sems can 'di dag kun/ /dang po gang las ji ltar byung*/ /dang po gsar skyes ma byung na/ /da lta sems can dmigs mi 'gyur/ /de dag la sogs dri ba mtha' yas pa'i/ /the tshom dri ba mang zhig mchis pa'i lan/ /rang byung chos rje bla mas gsung du gsol/ /de yis 'gro ba dpag med tshim par byed/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /rang byung rgyal ba'i zhing gi padmo la/ /skyes nas chos kyi dri ba rgya mtsho rnams/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rnams la dri bar shog /bdag kyang deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rang byung bla ma'i zhabs drung der skyes nas/ /chos kyi dga' ston rgya mtshor spyod byed cing*/ /the tshom kun bral zhi ba thob par shog / chos kyi rje rang byung rdo rje'i spyan sngar dri ba'i tshig le'ur bcad pa/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis phul ba/ phyogs dus kun tu bde chen gyi char bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin du 'bab par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
